def is_subset(self, other):
        """
        Return True if this Cartesian product is a subset of ``other``.

        For finite Cartesian products we construct an explicit ``FiniteSet`` of
        tuples representing the product and delegate the subset check to that
        set.  If any component set is infinite we fall back to the generic
        ``Set.is_subset`` implementation.
        """
        from sympy.sets.fancysets import FiniteSet
        from sympy.utilities.iterables import product as cartesian_product
        if all(s.is_finite_set for s in self.sets):
            elements = [list(s) for s in self.sets]
            tuples = [Tuple(*t) for t in cartesian_product(*elements)]
            explicit = FiniteSet(*tuples)
            return explicit.is_subset(other)
        return super().is_subset(other)

    def _kind(self):
        return SetKind(TupleKind(*(i.kind.element_kind for i in self.args)))

    def __len__(self):
        return reduce(lambda a, b: a*b, (len(s) for s in self.args))

    def __bool__(self):
        return all(self.sets)

    Per RFC 2616 Section 4.3, HEAD responses must not include a message body.
    """

    def test_head_request_no_body(self):
        """
        Test that HEAD requests do not return a response body.
        """
        # Simulate a HEAD request using Django's ServerHandler
        env = {"REQUEST_METHOD": "HEAD", "SERVER_PROTOCOL": "HTTP/1.0"}
        stdout = BytesIO()

        # Create a minimal request_handler with server attribute

        })()
